name: Fiano di Avellino
terms: Denominazione di Origine Controllata e Garantita, Italy's top tier. Stricter than DOC, and given only to wines that have been DOC for at least seven years.

notes: Fiano di Avellino is often pale straw, with strong aromas of spice and flowers.

blurb.text: A Campania white from 26 communes around Avellino, made from at least 85% Fiano, with Greco, Coda di Volpe Bianca and Trebbiano Toscano allowed in the rest.
